open_science_requirements: Open access obligations apply to publications and research data as standard for Horizon Europe RIA actions (EC-06, eligibility_conditions.json, source: HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.slice.json).
Communicable results must be shared with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform (CC-03, call_constraints.json, source: HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02.slice.json).
